testCase.name: [本地] S29 Interrupted work: a Save Note cut off by a reload or by opening the next patient, a recording that drops, and what stays on the device afterwards

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B27 · P2 · 新（部分已知）

失败状态提示不对或不清楚：Encounter 页 Generate 灰着但不说原因（已知 U59）；养老院 Save Note 被打断后提示说「文字被改过」；口述自动恢复后红色「断线」错误还挂着；快速口述转写失败时没有「⚠ 该怎么做」

票：TFA-94745 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：EFS/S06, TC-23/S08, TC-04/S28

思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S29 「被打断的工作：被重新加载或打开下一个病人打断的 Save Note、断掉的录音，以及之后设备上留下什么」 Interrupted work: a Save Note cut off by a reload or by opening the next patient, a recording that drops, and what stays on the device afterwards

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). Yesterday's panels are never silently reused.（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 AC 8；TFA-94745 state 3；UAT Empty & Failure States）
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af …（TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 2；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-94745 AC 5；UAT Empty & Failure States；UAT 3.5）
  • T7 A voice failure in the pre-round notes or Important Points channel loses nothing: a live recording is kept until its transcript is in the field (PR #95); …（TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-94745 comment 2026-10-05）
  • T8 No patient data is stored on the device beyond a minimal session cache: only the unsaved tail of a pre-round dictation (IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts', src/lib/localDrafts.ts; …（TFA-94745 AC 7；TFA-94745 comment 2026-10-05）
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given A fresh @roundai.test account with two Hospital patients (A, B) and two Nursing Home residents (A, B); ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes held about 8 s for A; the four existing e2e/unit recording specs

When (a) Save Note on A, reload during the hold. (b) Save Note on A, go back to the list and open B during the hold. (c) After a successful Save Note, read IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts' and the local audio store; sign out and read them again. …

Then (a) A shows 'structured processing was interrupted. Tap Save Note to continue', the text is kept, Generate is disabled. (b) A ends either updated with A's values or with that message (never silently stale); B's panels and tasks stay empty and show none of A's values. (c) No row for the chart once the server has the text; both stores empty after sign-out. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions from U6/T4 for (a)/(b), T8 for (c) (TFA-94745 AC 7 and Quinn's 2026-10-05 comment: only the unsaved tail, wiped on sign-out; PHI at rest is Q16), T7 for (d). On (b), B showing any of A's distinctive values (124/72, 15.1, Ceftriaxone 1; 138/76, 9.8) is a Fail

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S29 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92588 ready for pr；TFA-94745 ready for qa

养老院里 Save Note 被刷新打断后不提示「处理被中断」，唯一的提示却说预查房文字在处理后被改过，而医生并没有改。

In Nursing Home, a Save Note cut off by a reload shows no 'interrupted' message. The only hint says the pre-round text was edited after it was processed, which the physician did not do.

依据：allure b4241dc3: (a) passes in Hospital and fails in NH; (b) and (d) pass. The gates (U6/T4/U10) are ungated, judged now. Not in the dev report or the ledger: ledger U59 (EFS S06 on dev) covers only the Hospital Encounter tab in state B and checked NH only for A and D. A second finding (c): the saved text stays in IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts', and 'round-ai-local-audio' survives sign-out. That part is TC-10 Q16 / TFA-94745 open point A (PHI at rest), for Daniela to decide.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-b。

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S29

Interrupted work: a Save Note cut off by a reload or by opening the next patient, a recording that drops, and what stays on the device afterwards

Tickets: TFA-92588 Pre-Rounding Summary (ready for pr); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-b：newspec-b/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-b/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Chromium spec, fresh account, two patients and two residents: (a) Save Note on A with the parse held ~8 s at the socket, reload during the hold; (b) Save Note on A, go back and open B during the hold; (c) after a successful Save Note read IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts' and the local audio store, sign out, read again; (d) run the four existing unit specs with e2e/unit.config.ts -g titles. — Hold is a delay option in our own socket proxy; IndexedDB is read with page.evaluate; unit specs exist.

Detail:

(a) Hospital pass ('…structured processing was interrupted. Tap Save Note to continue.', text kept, Generate disabled). (a) Nursing Home: text kept and Generate disabled, but no interrupted message; the Encounter tab says 'The pre-round text was edited after it was last processed…'. (b) both modes pass: moving to B inside the app during the 8 s hold, A ends with A's values, B shows none of them. (c) after a successful Save Note the note text stays in IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts' (still there after reopening the chart); sign-out clears that store but not 'round-ai-local-audio' (a kept recording survives). (d) the four unit specs pass.

产品问题：(1) Nursing Home, Save Note cut off by a reload: no 'interrupted' message; the only hint says the physician edited the text, which they did not (TC-10 U6/T4, U10). (2) The saved pre-round note stays on the device in IndexedDB after the server has it, and recorded audio in the local audio store is not wiped at sign-out (TC-10 T8 / TFA-94745 AC 7; PHI at rest is Q16).

证据：附了 6 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our chromium spec, not written yet, plus Tim's e2e/unit specs): an action-observer hold on ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes, two patients per mode on a fresh account seeded with the local admin key, IndexedDB reads and a sign-out; on dev nothing may sign out, there is no action mock and no a…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
